en: A sepia-toned photograph of a European city with a prominent baroque church tower in the foreground, a busy street with people and cars, and a hill with a clock tower and fortifications in the background. The architecture is typical of Central Europe, and the street scene suggests an early to mid-20th century period. The bottom of the postcard has the text 'GRAZ. NEUTORGASSE u. SCHLOSSBERG.'
